question: Did L-BFGS-B candidate fits marked ABNORMAL alter the reported null-mock search statistic or candidate minima?
hypothesis: If the warnings are line-search termination near an adequate minimum, direct score reconstruction and a differently scaled/profiled solver should return the same objective to numerical tolerance.
assumptions_and_units: Same BAO forward model and full released covariance as the source run.
The positive free alpha amplitude is analytically profiled for the alternative solver; shape parameters are optimized on a unit box.

model_parameters_and_priors.search_domain: The exact per-candidate bounds from the originating result; not priors.
model_parameters_and_priors.solver: Powell on unit-scaled shape parameters plus a reconditioned L-BFGS-B retry; full-covariance alpha profile.

nuisance_parameters.alpha: analytically profiled from full-covariance quadratic at each shape point

training_validation_holdout_definition: Reconstructed each original 200-mock realization from the recorded seed, fitted LCDM mean and covariance Cholesky; rechecked all 52 candidates whose saved best L-BFGS-B run was marked unsuccessful under either start budget.
covariance_order_and_overlap_treatment: Full released 13x13 covariance in original measurement order; no other data/probe combined.

numerical_checks.retry_successes: all 52 cases report successful alternative solver exits

metric_definition: Difference between the best checked alternative/profiled objective and the direct covariance score recomputed at the original candidate parameters.
uncertainty: This is an optimizer-status diagnostic, not a proof of global optimality; it tests only the recorded nonconverged candidate points and center starts.
interpretation_and_limits: ABNORMAL statuses are a visible optimizer limitation, but in this deterministic recheck they did not shift any saved candidate by more than 1e-7 or the selected null tail statistic.
independent_reviewer: Root implementation using direct full-covariance score reconstruction and a distinct profile-amplitude optimization parameterization.
review_disposition: Accepted as a bounded nonconvergence check; do not erase the original ABNORMAL messages from the source run.
next_test: Keep exact optimizer messages with future null mocks; increase mock count only if the estimate remains a report's main claim.
